tasks.label: ci
args: npm ci && exec npm run ci

tasks.label: dev-preview
args: export DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_SHOW_MAGIC_LINKS_ON_CONSOLE=true DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_ALLOW_INSECURE_SESSION_COOKIES=true; _created_dev_vars=false; if [ ! -e .dev.vars ]; then printf 'DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_SHOW_MAGIC_LINKS_ON_CONSOLE=%s\nDGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_ALLOW_INSECURE_SESSION_COOKIES=%s\n' "$DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_SHOW_MAGIC_LINKS_ON_CONSOLE" "$DGHK_DEBUG_ONLY_DANGEROUS_ALLOW_INSECURE_SESSION_COOKIES" > .dev.vars; _created_dev_vars=true; fi; trap '[ "$_created_dev_vars" = true ] && rm -f .dev.vars' EXIT; npm ci && env CI=1 npm run dev

tasks.label: storybook
args: npm ci && exec npm run storybook -- --host "${DGHK_STORYBOOK_BIND:-127.0.0.1}" --port "${DGHK_STORYBOOK_PORT:-6006}"
